梅开二度！（梅开二度！（第22页）“你先前镇压上古者时，有三十六符箓中的五雷符箓加持，都没能把那黑棺劈碎。”“这会儿就你一个，就想轻描淡写雷死我？”“你觉得可能吗？”“知错不改，就好好赔偿我悟道中断带来损失吧。”抬头招呼瓦格罗：“把门关上，小爷我要劫个色。”“用她身体还债。”“你敢！”徐养虚讨债不成，反把她变成债，捶债肉还，慌的奋力挣扎厉声喝骂。瞪圆双目如同发怒老虎。气场弱点的被她这么一吓，借人十个胆子都不敢放肆，魂窍石人却别的没有就胆子大。双膝一蹬身体浮空，伸直双腿抱着她往石床上走。反过来吓破她胆。什么女汉子，彪汉子，通通跑的不见影子。没什么家具石室中。传出她娇躯哆嗦求饶：“不可以，你不能这么对我！”“我还是”哦豁——心里一急嘴上就把不住门，自己把自己老楚女隐秘传开。传得观战众人目瞪口呆，姜乐瑶掏出手机笑嘻嘻录像。房门即将被瓦格罗关上之际，一道青色身影忽然出手。手持雷简以极快速度穿过石门，冲到石床上救人。看得魂窍石人好笑。就她们这真人积精实力，再来个姜乐瑶都不是对手。怎么救得出人。手臂一伸一擒，轻轻松松将救人者擒拿住。丢到石床上禁锢。弄出个双美同寝。石门合上瞬间，一道难得一见哑巴开口惊呼传出：“你个臭流氓快放开我，好多人看着呐！”话一入耳。十几双眼睛齐刷刷看向另一哑巴秦翘楚。看得他摇头叹气。师妹莽撞。不是她的祸硬上往上凑，逼得他这同门师兄不得不出手。双臂一伸，放出五雷扇混元雷尺，握在手中正要大闹一场，一道红色身影却抢先他一步。堵住石门不让进。站在门口不掏法器不放真灵，反而抽掉头发上插着玉叉。放任满头秀发散开披在肩头，露出极具妩媚诱惑面容，哼哧一声呵斥身后秦木头：“还嫌事闹的不够大吗，退下吧，让我去说服他。”姜乐瑶说完伸出玉手推门，扭动水蛇蛮腰风姿绰约走进去此时，血族祖殿内情况乱成锅粥，距离这儿两百多公里远，圣墓骑士团教堂内局势。却比这边还乱。谈判谈的顺顺利利。突然杀过来个血族上古者，外加六大华夏神、人、妖魂。杀他们个措手不及。仅仅数分钟工夫，从别的教堂抽调过来高阶教会、骑士成员，就全被上古者吸成人皮干。大摇大摆杀进教堂底下禁地，见到个被重重镣铐锁住。铐在十字架上老男人。衣衫褴褛面容枯槁，跟截风干掉干木头没区别。死气沉沉。却在众人进来一瞬间。藏在枯草长发下眼眸，突然绽放猩红血光，嗓音沙哑嘶吼：“回来了，你们终于回来了！”“怎么样，想通了吗，是不是要放我出去？”莉奥薇此行来这，确实是要放一只大魔出去。却不能随随便便放。四大凶恶魔头中，狼魔是她死敌，食人魔神志不清。都不能放。唯二可以斟酌的，就是这巫妖和大魔导师

Scored twice! (Two goals! (Page 22) "When you suppressed the ancients before, even with the blessing of the Five Thunder Talismans among the thirty-six talismans, you could not break the black coffin." "You are the only one who wants to downplay the death of thunder." "Me?" "Do you think it's possible?" "If you don't correct your mistake, just compensate me for the loss caused by the interruption of my enlightenment." He raised his head and said to Vaguero: "Close the door. I want to use her body to pay off the debt." "How dare you!" Xu Yangxu failed to collect the debt, so he turned her into a debtor and beat the debtor's flesh to repay it. His eyes widened like an angry tiger, and he was frightened by her. He didn't dare to be presumptuous, but he was brave enough to push his body up into the air, straighten his legs and carry her to the stone bed. In turn, she was frightened, and she couldn't even see a trace of such a strong man. There was no furniture in the stone room. She was trembling and begging for mercy: "No, you can't do this to me!" Open. Everyone watching was dumbfounded. Jiang Leyao took out his phone and recorded the video with a smile. Just as the door was about to be closed by Vaguero, a cyan figure suddenly shot through the stone door with a Lei Jian in hand and rushed towards it. It was funny to see the Soul Awakening Stone Man. With their strength, even Jiang Leyao could easily catch the rescuer with one stretch of his arm. Imprisonment. The moment the stone door closed, a rare mute voice came out: "You stinky scoundrel, let me go, there are many people watching!" A dozen pairs of eyes caught his eye. Looking at the other mute, Qin Qiaochu, he shook his head and sighed. It was not her fault that forced his fellow disciple to take action, and held the Five Thunder Fans in his hands. Just as he was about to make a scene, a red figure blocked the stone door and refused to let him in. Instead, he took out the jade fork from his hair and let it hang on his shoulders. With a very charming and seductive face, Jiang Leyao scolded Qin Mumu behind him: "Don't you think the trouble is not big enough? Step back and let me persuade him." After speaking, Jiang Leyao stretched out her jade hand to push the door, twisting the water snake's waist gracefully When we walked in, the situation in the Blood Clan Ancestral Palace was in chaos. More than two hundred kilometers away, the situation in the Church of the Holy Sepulchre was even more chaotic than here. The negotiation went smoothly. , plus six Chinese gods, humans, and demon spirits. In just a few minutes, all the high-level church members and knights transferred from other churches were sucked into their skins by the ancient ones. Entering the forbidden area under the church, I saw an old man who was heavily shackled and handcuffed to a cross. His clothes were ragged and his face was as dead as if he had been killed by Jie Feng. Under the withered hair, his eyes suddenly glowed with scarlet blood, and he shouted hoarsely: "You're back, you're finally back!" "How about it, have you figured it out? Are you going to let me out?" Leovey came here to really let a big demon out, but she couldn't let it out casually. Among the four fierce demons, the wolf demon is her mortal enemy, and the ogre is unconscious. The only two that can be considered are the lich and the great magister.
